Hold the 30-minute session with Sam on agent-loop integration points and ask Lena to schedule the Halvorsen, Brightwater and Kestrel interviews.

Circulate the RFC draft to Sam, Grace and Marcus. Present at roadmap sync with a phased plan and a staffing ask: Jordan as owner, Sam as agent-side lead, Wei and Farah on slices. Leave with R-14 moved to Now or Next, Jordan named owner, and linked KRs PE-KR1, AE-KR1, AE-KR2 and GTM-KR1.

Finalize the RFC with sign-off from Platform and Agent Eng (adopted by 2+ teams), incorporating customer interview findings and Grace's isolation review. Claim /src/memory/ in CODEOWNERS. Agree on memory tasks with Tobias in R-12. Give Halvorsen a dated plan in time for the exec sponsor call.

Ship the commit-keyed persistent index (Phase 1a) behind a flag. Measure PE-KR1 p95 and the cross-session cache hit rate, and agree with Nadia on sandbox boot integration. Sam's side lands memory write/inject in agent-loop. Wei and Farah own named sub-components, with Jordan reviewing.

Release Phase 1 memory store (fed by PR review comments, corrections and repo ADRs; admin-manageable, policy-scoped, audit-logged) to Halvorsen, Brightwater and Kestrel ahead of Halvorsen's 12/15 renewal. Track repeat-mistake tickets on FL-4412, FL-4430 and FL-4471 patterns.

Publish a results write-up with business-outcome numbers: AE-KR1 multi-session success, AE-KR2 tickets, PE-KR1/PE-KR2, renewal outcomes and Brightwater expansion status. Draft the Phase 2 RFC and a retrieval/context vision doc for Kai. Give Priya promo-packet evidence for the H1 2027 cycle.

headline: Step forward as the named cross-team owner of R-14 Agent Memory before the 10/21 roadmap sync. It is the company's top unowned priority, it sits in the ingest/retrieval code Jordan already owns, and it is the clearest way to close all three gaps the H1 2026 calibration committee named: a cross-team initiative, an adopted RFC, and business-outcome impact.

levelGaps.evidence: Jordan diagnosed the session-keyed cache as the root cause behind the PE-KR1 gap and Halvorsen CPU spikes (1,904 full re-indexes from 1,912 sessions). They also scoped R-14 more concretely than anyone in three months. However, the H2 2025 review notes their work is 'scoped by tickets others write,' and their own self-reflection says they 'keep seeing the systemic fix and then leaving it for someone else' (jr-review-h2-2025, jr-self-reflection-q3-2026, internal/slack/2026-09-24-eng-platform-reindex.md).
levelGaps.expectation: Problems that span multiple teams or services; identifies the problems worth solving, not just solutions to assigned ones; comfortable owning something nobody has asked them to own.

levelGaps.evidence: Technical depth is acknowledged as L5 (retrieval v2 took hit@10 from 58% to 71%; ingest v2 cut build time from 22 to 8 min). But there are zero cross-team design docs in three halves, retrieval v2 notes lived only in PR FL-2811, and the H2 2025 design-doc goal was not met. Kai Nakamura asked for a written retrieval vision (jr-review-h1-2026, jr-shipped-retrieval-v2, jr-peer-feedback-h1-2026).
levelGaps.expectation: Sets technical direction through written design docs/RFCs reviewed and adopted beyond their own team; 1–2 substantial cross-team design docs per half. Promo evidence: 'Cross-team RFC, adopted by 2+ teams.'

levelGaps.evidence: Agent Eng credited retrieval v2 with about 6 points of task success. Even so, the committee noted Jordan frames impact 'in latency and hit-rate metrics, not business outcomes,' and Jordan names under-communicating business impact as a weakness (jr-shipped-retrieval-v2, jr-review-h1-2026, jr-self-reflection-q3-2026).
levelGaps.expectation: Measurable business impact: work clearly moves a company-level goal (ARR, retention, win rate) or a department KR beyond their own team, and they can articulate it in numbers.

levelGaps.evidence: Jordan coordinated the INC-188 fix across Platform, Agent Eng and IDE in 9 hours, but did not drive the systemic follow-up program. Sam Okafor noted Jordan 'only share[s] it when asked,' and Jordan says they are uncomfortable directing people outside their manager's team. No cross-team initiative has yet been led from proposal to delivery (jr-shipped-inc-188, jr-peer-feedback-h1-2026, jr-review-h1-2026).
levelGaps.expectation: Leads cross-team initiatives from proposal through delivery: aligns managers and PMs, negotiates scope, gets work onto the roadmap, and influences roadmap priorities.

levelGaps.evidence: Mentoring of Wei Chen was noted positively but is within-team. Wei called Jordan a 'patient pairing partner.' Priya plans to hand the R-04 remainder to Wei with Jordan reviewing (jr-review-h1-2026, jr-peer-feedback-h1-2026, internal/one-on-ones/2026-10-08-jordan-rivera-priya-shah.md).
levelGaps.expectation: Mentors L3/L4 engineers across teams; grows the next owners of their area so they aren't a single point of failure. Promo evidence: 'others lead parts of their initiative.'
